value.rationale: All nearest-neighbor potentials are a natural complete finite-dimensional class on a non-sofic rational frequency shift. The result exactly classifies zero-temperature frozen phases, positive-entropy renewal equilibria, and first-order coexistence where strict pressure-gap uniqueness is inapplicable; two natural edge rewards exhibit fundamentally different critical laws, one k-dependent algebraic and the other universal golden-ratio. The result is not implied by a zero-potential MME or a bare generic renewal technique and supplies phase diagrams relevant to perturbative equilibrium selection.
